verdict.rationale: Otter documents its own event-driven automations: meeting takeaways automatically become Zendesk/ServiceNow tickets, deal details sync to the CRM, and the notetaker auto-joins scheduled meetings. Its pricing also lists 'Otter API & Webhooks' and Zapier integrations, and it claims teams can 'trigger actions based on meeting content'. However, there is no evidence of a user-facing rule builder with configurable conditions; the automations appear to be fixed integrations, and custom triggers rely on the API, webhooks or Zapier (developer building blocks and third-party tools). Missing for 10: a documented native rule/condition editor, user-configurable triggers and actions, documentation of webhook event types, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Automatically turn meeting takeaways into support tickets or updates in tools like Zendesk and ServiceNow.
Key deal details, notes, and next steps automatically extracted from every meeting and synced to your CRM.
Teams can automatically ingest meeting transcripts into internal knowledge bases or trigger actions based on meeting content
